                                         Figure 1. AT-VLA improves upon previous VLA approaches in contact-rich tasks by introducing Adaptive Tactile Injection, which balances
                                         pretrained knowledge with the learning of newly incorporated tactile representations. Furthermore, it enables rapid and accurate action
                                         adjustments based on tactile feedback through a Tactile Reaction Dual-Stream Strategy.

Figure 2. Framework of AT-VLA. The tactile gate adaptively determines whether tactile tokens should be used as conditional inputs for
action generation within the Action Expert module. When the tactile gate is inactive, all input modalities of the Action Expert operate at the
same frequency. When activated, the tactile signal is processed at a higher frequency to enable rapid and precise action adjustments.
